delta: Birth/adoption/foster relief requires descendant-minimum entitlement. For the second/third-and-later amount, the preceding children counted for ordering must have been held for **more than 183 days**. Exclude a child adopted during the year from the foster route; use the birth/adoption route where entitled. Share the applicable amount equally between entitled declaring taxpayers. The birth/adoption amount continues for two following years; the fostering amount follows actual qualifying days. Multiple adoption requires at least two adoptions on the same date. The event credits a/b/c are compatible with one another and d under the express statutory conditions ([art. 4.Uno.a–d](https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-1998-8202#a4)).
